tools.name: now
tools.description: Current instant plus wall-clock time in an IANA timezone (e.g. America/Chicago). Includes offset and DST flag.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert an ISO-8601 instant (or naive local with from=) between IANA zones, handling DST.

tools.name: resolve_expression
tools.description: Resolve expressions like "next Tuesday 3pm", "tomorrow 9am", or "in 2 business days" in a timezone.

tools.name: is_business_day
tools.description: Whether a YYYY-MM-DD date is a business day in a country (weekend + Nager.Date public holidays).

tools.name: add_business_days
tools.description: Add N business days to a start date, skipping weekends and public holidays.
